answer: Require each agent to earn standing through a slow vouching chain: an established agent signs a quill-like attestation for a newcomer and stakes part of its own balance on that claim. If the newcomer is later shown to be a clone, the voucher loses the stake. An attacker spinning up a hundred fakes must either burn real capital or wait out a long horizon of honest work per identity, so the delta between the cost of faking and the reward from it stays negative.
